findings.title: average() divides by zero for an empty list
findings.detail: average([]) returns NaN: values.length is 0, so the division has no meaning. Return 0 or throw a clear error for an empty list, and add a test for it.

findings.title: Unused variable `trimmed`
findings.detail: greet() computes trimmed but still greets with name, so the trim has no effect. Use trimmed in the greeting, or remove the line.

body.summary: Two findings, no blocker: an empty list breaks average(), and greet() has an unused variable.
